column11: Joshua Van won the title after Alexandre Pantoja suffered a freak injury during their fight
Joshua Van won the title after Alexandre Pantoja suffered a freak injury during their fight
Aljamain Sterling won the title by DQ
O'Malley defended the belt against Chito Vera who was, by unanimous consensus, not the no.1 contender. O'Malley then lost his belt against the no.1 contender Merab Dvalishvili in his next fight
Jamahal Hill's title shot was circumstancial as the former champion - Jiri Prochazka - was injured and the two next in-line - Mahomed Ankalaev and Jan Blachowicz -  drew in their title fight
Tom Aspinall was the interim champion but not given the next title shot
